content: Kavya Iyer followed up with agent Vikram Singh regarding a payment error that caused her travel policy to expire. Vikram confirmed the issue was due to a technical glitch and informed her that reinstating the policy requires a total of 3000 INR (2500 INR premium plus a 500 INR reinstatement fee). Kavya agreed to the amount and requested an online payment link.

action_items: Send online payment link or details to the customer
